======================================================================
Member pointers and template specializations
======================================================================

template <typename T, bool Value = false> struct traits;
template <typename C, typename R, typename... A>
struct traits<R (C::*)(A...) const, false> { int f(int x) { if (x) return 1; return 0; } };
struct C { int value; int f(double) const; };
using Data = int C::*;
using Function = int (C::*)(double) const;
using Qualified = int (C::* const)(double) const;
namespace N { template <typename T> struct Box { int f() const; }; }
using Nested = int (N::Box<int>::*)() const;

---

======================================================================
Global delete operand binding
======================================================================

void release(int **p, bool b) { ::delete[] p[b ? 0 : 1]; ::delete p[0]; delete *p; }

---
